migration_sets.ownership_note: SQLite catalog is owned by identity-management; ledger table identity_migrations records the applied revisions.

019_identity_authorization_foundation.sql is a single shared workspace-level file that creates the identity-management, organization and policy tables in one public schema and is embedded wholesale by runtime-migration; identity-management owns only its own statements inside it.

compatibility.authority: platform product version 0.1.0 from the root [workspace.package]; no upper bound has been declared or reviewed

declaration_authority.module_id: docs/plans/current/PLAN-0014-reference-conformance-and-r2-module-readiness.md §6 names identity as a Wave 5 pilot candidate.
declaration_authority.module_version: First independent release version for this module; docs/standards/SAAS_MODULE_STANDARD.md §8 requires a module release version separate from the workspace/product version, and 0.1.0-rc.1 states that the candidate is not GA. The workspace version stays 0.1.0.
declaration_authority.owned_bounded_contexts: crates/identity/Cargo.toml [package.metadata.architecture] bounded_context = identity-management, checked against docs/architecture/BOUNDED_CONTEXT_MAP.md.
declaration_authority.platform_capabilities: No authoritative platform capability catalog exists yet (PLAN-0014 Wave 2 review G-204 registry is DEFER), so none is declared instead of inventing identifiers.
declaration_authority.published_commands: Application use cases in crates/identity/src/application, reachable from the IAM admin HTTP surface in apps/business-api/src/routes/iam_admin.rs. Contract version 1.0.0 is the initial declaration of this surface.
declaration_authority.published_queries: Query use cases in crates/identity/src/application/queries.rs, reachable from apps/business-api/src/routes/iam_admin.rs. Contract version 1.0.0 is the initial declaration of this surface.
declaration_authority.published_events: Not found: identity publishes no integration events today, so the set stays empty rather than being invented (docs/standards/INTER_MODULE_COMMUNICATION_STANDARD.md §6).
declaration_authority.resource_kinds: Not declared: identity publishes no ResourceRef resource kind yet; adding one is a published-contract change recorded as design proposal SP-5.
declaration_authority.data_classification: docs/architecture/SECURITY_ARCHITECTURE.md §8: authentication identifiers and membership facts are Confidential.
declaration_authority.migration_namespace: Equal to the authoritative data_owner, per docs/reviews/2026-09-24-saas-align-module-packaging.md §8 G-203 / §16 D-02.
declaration_authority.persistent: identity owns platform_users, external_identities, tenant_memberships, identity_idempotency and platform_bootstrap_executions.
declaration_authority.dependencies: identity declares no dependency on another business module; crates/identity-authorization-contracts is an adapter behaviour-contract suite consumed as a dev-dependency, not a module dependency.
declaration_authority.compatibility: No platform compatibility window has been reviewed or accepted; the minimum is pinned to the current platform version and no maximum is claimed.
